title: Implement test mode with fake database
description:
Add a test/fake mode that redirects pebbles to use an in-memory or temporary database instead of .pebbles directory, enabling safe testing of editing commands.

User story: As a developer, I want to test pebbles commands and scripts without affecting my real issue database, so I can validate behavior and write automated tests safely.

Requirements:
- Environment variable or CLI flag to enable test mode (e.g., PEBBLES_TEST_MODE or --test-db)
- Test mode uses temporary directory or in-memory storage
- Test mode clearly indicates it's active (prefix output, different prompt color, etc.)
- Can populate test database with fixture data
- Clean isolation between test and production data
- Works with all commands (new, update, delete, link, etc.)

Benefits:
- Safe experimentation with commands
- Automated test suites for pebbles itself
- Testing of scripts that use pebbles
- Training and demos without polluting real data

Implementation ideas:
- Storage trait with FileStorage and InMemoryStorage implementations
- Test fixture helpers for common scenarios
- Clear visual indicators when in test mode
